title: MCP Server
name: Mcp
description: Lets AI assistants such as Claude read your pages over the Model Context Protocol. Read-only by default; tokens you allow can save edits as drafts for you to review. With a rate limit and a request log.
author: ImpressPages community

options.label: Enable the MCP endpoint
options.name: enabled
options.note: The endpoint is /mcp on your site. Create API tokens under MCP Server in the admin menu.

options.label: Require HTTPS
options.name: httpsOnly
options.note: Refuses plain HTTP so tokens are never sent unencrypted. Requests from this computer (127.0.0.1) are always allowed, for local testing.

options.label: Include hidden and password-protected pages
options.name: includeHidden
options.note: Off: assistants only see what a visitor can see.
